title.zh: 均匀性与充电：高束流不只是更快
title.en: Uniformity and charging: high beam current means more than speed

subtitle.zh: 扫描轨迹 / 束斑 /电荷中和 /晶圆温升
subtitle.en: Scan trajectory / beam spot / charge neutralization / wafer heating

body.zh: 01 整形束斑
body.en: 01 Shape the beam spot

body.zh: 02 设定扫描轨迹
body.en: 02 Set the scan trajectory

body.zh: 03 晶圆扫描或旋转
body.en: 03 Scan or rotate the wafer

body.zh: 04 中和表面电荷
body.en: 04 Neutralize surface charge

body.zh: 05 监控温度与束流
body.en: 05 Monitor temperature and beam current

body.zh: 06 检查剂量均匀性
body.en: 06 Check dose uniformity

body.zh: 扫描速度与波形；决定相邻轨迹重叠；和局部剂量分布
body.en: Scan speed and waveform Determine overlap of adjacent tracks and local dose distribution

body.zh: 束斑与电流密度；影响横向分布；与空间电荷效应
body.en: Beam spot and current density Affect lateral distribution and space-charge effects

body.zh: 晶圆位置与角度；晶向、倾角和旋转；影响投影与通道效应
body.en: Wafer position and angle Crystal orientation, tilt and rotation affect projection and channeling

body.zh: 电荷中和与热管理；低能电子中和正电荷；并控制晶圆温升
body.en: Charge neutralization and thermal management Low-energy electrons neutralize positive charge while wafer heating is controlled

body.zh: 片内均匀性来自束流、扫描与晶圆运动的协同
body.en: Within-wafer uniformity requires coordination of beam, scanning and wafer motion

body.zh: 电荷中和：动态平衡；正离子入射；低能电子中和；二次电子发射
body.en: Charge neutralization: dynamic balance Positive-ion incidence Low-energy electron neutralization Secondary-electron emission

body.zh: 电子中和可降低表面正电荷，；但并非在所有区域都能完全消除充电。
body.en: Electron neutralization reduces positive surface charge, but cannot fully eliminate charging in every region

body.zh: 提高束流：产能提升 ↔ 空间电荷、温升与充电风险增加
body.en: Increasing beam current: higher throughput ↔ greater space charge, heating and charging risk

body.zh: 产能提升；在相同时间内；可完成更多晶圆
body.en: Higher throughput Within the same time, more wafers can be processed

body.zh: 但同时；带来多重耦合效应
body.en: At the same time, multiple coupled effects arise

body.zh: 扫描条纹/径向偏差；由轨迹重叠、束斑形状；或扫描参数不当引起
body.en: Scan stripes / radial bias Caused by track overlap, beam shape or inappropriate scan parameters

body.zh: 局部充电；电子中和不足时；易产生局部正电荷
body.en: Local charging Insufficient electron neutralization can produce local positive charge

body.zh: 薄介质损伤；表面充电可能引发；薄介质电场过高
body.en: Thin-dielectric damage Surface charging can cause excessive electric field in thin dielectrics

body.zh: 光刻胶温升变形；高束流导致局部温升；影响光刻胶稳定性
body.en: Thermal deformation of photoresist High beam current causes local heating, affecting resist stability

body.zh: 量测反馈：束流剖面 / Faraday/ 片阻图/充电监控
body.en: Metrology feedback: beam profile / Faraday / sheet-resistance map / charge monitoring

body.zh: 束流剖面；监测束斑形状与均匀性
body.en: Beam profile Monitor beam shape and uniformity

body.zh: Faraday；监测实际束流强度
body.en: Faraday Monitor actual beam current

body.zh: 片阻图；退火后评估片内均匀性
body.en: Sheet-resistance map Assess within-wafer uniformity after annealing

body.zh: 充电监控；监测表面电位变化趋势
body.en: Charge monitoring Monitor surface-potential trends

body.zh: 离子束
body.en: Ion beam

body.zh: （整形束斑）
body.en: (shaped spot)
